##### Project general facts

311 Boulevard by BAMX Development is a contemporary residential building with a distinctive architectural identity, combining modern design with functionality. The concept is based on a balance between flowing lines and precise geometry, while green alleys, lush planting and modern lighting create a calm, welcoming environment. The building rises above three basement levels and a ground floor to fifteen residential floors and a roof with shared amenities, offering studios and one-, two- and three-bedroom apartments.

Amenities are spread across several levels of the building. Residents enjoy an infinity pool and a children's pool, a health club with a fully equipped gym, a sauna and a jacuzzi, and indoor and outdoor yoga areas. Squash courts, a mini golf course, a party deck, indoor and rooftop cinemas, rooftop gardens, a sunken seating area, barbecue zones and children's play areas add variety, supported by smart home systems, high-speed internet and covered parking.

Layouts are designed for comfort, with spacious living rooms and panoramic glazing that brings in plenty of natural light. Interiors by Belmore Collection Milano feature marble accents, sleek wooden finishes and refined designer furniture that create an elegant atmosphere. Homes are delivered fully furnished, offering a complete, ready-to-move-in solution for owner-occupiers and a turnkey option for investors.

##### Location description and benefits

Jumeirah Village Circle is a vibrant, family-friendly community at the centre of the city, known for its circular layout of landscaped parks, low- and mid-rise residential buildings and townhouses. Circle Mall, the community park network, neighbourhood cafes, supermarkets, nurseries, schools and clinics cover daily needs close to home and give the area a green, relaxed character.

Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Khail Road connect residents with the wider city. Circle Mall is a short drive away, Emirates Hills, Jumeirah Lake Towers and Dubai Marina are close by, and Downtown Dubai, Burj Khalifa and Dubai International Airport are within comfortable reach for work, leisure and travel.

Jumeirah Village Circle is a freehold community open to international buyers and one of the most popular rental markets in Dubai. A central position between the coastal districts and the inland business hubs attracts young professionals and families, supporting high occupancy and steady demand. Fully furnished homes with resort-style amenities and competitive prices underpin attractive rental yields and long-term value for owners.
